s0C8000.name: Overworld Map16 tile number table
summary: Large table of 8x8 tile numbers read by the overworld event engine in bank 04 (CODE_04EAF4: LDA.L DATA_0C8000,X).
Indexed by map position; the matching attributes come from the parallel table at $7F:0000. SYSTEM_NOTES calls it
'OW Map16 definitions'. Exact row layout not decoded.

s0C9380.name: Stripe image: clear credits tilemaps
summary: Stripe image number $D2 (see ImagePointers), loaded when the credits start. Two RLE records fill VRAM $2000 and $3000
with blank tiles ($F8/$00 and $FA/$08), then $FF ends the image.

s0C938D.name: Ending mode entry points
summary: Four JSL entry points called from bank 00 game modes. Each sets the data bank to $0C.
$0C938D: credits, every frame (game mode $1B): scroll text and layers (CODE_0C9F6A) and run the background fade (CODE_0CAB1F).
$0C939A: Yoshi's House (mode $1F): draw the sprite grid (CODE_0CA0E3) and run the scene (CODE_0CA1D4).
$0C93A5: enemy parade (mode $25): CODE_0CAEAD.
$0C93AD: mode $21 wait: counts [$145B] down; at zero sets game mode $23 and [$1DE9] = $FF.

s0C93C1.name: Pointer table: credits background data
summary: Seven 16-bit pointers into bank $0C, indexed by [$1928] * 2. Each points to RLE compressed Map16 numbers for one credits background.

s0C93CF.name: Table: credits tile word masks
summary: Seven words ANDed with each tile word of the matching background: $FFFF keeps bit 8 of the tile number, $FEFF clears it.

s0C93DD.name: Load credits backgrounds into tilemaps
summary: Called once from the credits setup (bank 00 $0094A3). For each of the 7 backgrounds in [$1928]: decompresses the RLE Map16 numbers
to $7E:B900 (CODE_0C944C, also builds a pointer table at $0FBE to the Map16 definitions at $0D:9100), then expands each 16x16
Map16 into four 8x8 tile words at $7F:4000 + [$1928] * $800 (CODE_0C94C0). Finally DMAs background 0 (CODE_0C9567), resets the text
pointers, initializes the jumping objects and starts the credits music.
RLE format: control byte; bit 7 set = repeat the next byte (count-1) times, clear = copy count literal bytes. FF FF ends the data.
$0C944C: decompression. $0C94C0: Map16 to tilemap conversion (16 Map16 per row, two passes of 128).

s0C9559.name: Table: DMA setup for credits tilemap
summary: Two 7 byte records copied to $4310-$4316: DMAP $01, B-bus $18 (VRAM data), source $7F:4000 / $7F:4400, size $0400.

s0C9567.name: DMA credits background to VRAM
summary: Called through JSL from NMI (bank 00 $008203) and from the credits setup. Copies the $0800 byte tilemap of background [$1928]
from $7F:4000 + [$1928] * $0800 to VRAM $30C0 and $34C0 in two DMAs, then clears the reload request [$1FFE].

s0C95C7.name: Credits text records
summary: Records of: starting column, byte count - 1, then tile/attribute words (2 bytes per tile). Small font: tiles $00-$09 digits,
$0A-$23 letters, attr $28/$3C. Big font: top half tiles $C0-$CF (A-P) and $E0-$E9 (Q-Z), bottom half +$10, attr $38. $FC = blank.
Each name takes two rows (top and bottom half). A byte $FF at $0C95EC is the shared empty entry. Comments show the decoded text.

s0C9D18.name: Pointer table: credits text rows
summary: One word per BG3 text row, indexed by [$67] * 2: offset into the records at DATA_0C95C7, or $0026 (an $FF byte) for an empty row.
Comments list the row numbers and offsets.

s0C9EAC.name: Stripe record: blank text row
summary: Body of a stripe record appended before each credits text row: RLE ($40), length $3E+1 = 64 bytes of tile $FC attr $00, then $FF.

s0C9EB1.name: Queue next credits text row
summary: Appends records to the stripe buffer at $7F:837D (index in $7F:837B): first a blank row at VRAM address [$66]:[$65], then the
text record for row [$67] (if any) at column offset. Then advances [$65] by $20 (one tilemap row), wrapping inside the BG3 map.
Called when BG3 has scrolled one more tile row.

s0C9F5C.name: Table: credits transition scroll positions
summary: BG3 V-scroll ([$24]) values at which the background transition starts, then the final scroll position $0559.

s0C9F6A.name: Credits scroll update
summary: Per-frame credits scrolling with 8.8 fixed point speeds ($1446,X speed, $144E,X sub-pixel): BG2 H-scroll [$1E] moves -0.5 px/frame,
BG3 V-scroll [$24] moves +0.25 px/frame until $0559. Queues a text row every 8 pixels, starts the background transition ([$1B88] = 1)
at the table positions, then falls into drawing Mario and Yoshi.
$0C9FCB: adds speed [$1446,X] to position [$00,X] using sub-pixel accumulator [$144E,X].

s0C9FE7.name: Table: Yoshi piece Y offsets
summary: Indexed by [$1602]: +0, -1, +0 (added to base Y $85).

s0C9FEA.name: Draw Mario and Yoshi in the credits
summary: Places Mario at ($0038,$008F), Super, walking right, and sprite slot 0 as Yoshi (sprite $35) at ($52,$8F), animates them, draws two extra
OAM pieces and then moves and draws the 7 jumping objects (hedged: probably the rescued Yoshi eggs).

s0CA043.name: Table: jumping object start positions
summary: $0CA043: X positions $63-$C3 (step $10). $0CA04A: Y positions $A0/$9C alternating (7 objects each).

s0CA051.name: Initialize credits jumping objects
summary: Clears the per-object tables ($0B23, $0B32) and sets 7 objects (index $07-$0D): X/Y from the tables above, speed from DATA_0CA3C2,
$0AF6 = 1. Also Mario faces right and [$1B89] = $E2.

s0CA08F.name: Table: Yoshi's House grid tile numbers
summary: 42 OAM tile numbers for a 14x3 grid of 16x16 sprites (probably scenery decoration); $FF = empty cell.

s0CA0B9.name: Table: Yoshi's House grid properties
summary: 42 OAM property bytes matching the tile numbers ($77 = X-flipped); $FF = empty cell.

s0CA0E3.name: Draw Yoshi's House sprite grid
summary: Fills OAM from $0290 with the 14x3 grid: X from $10 step $10 to $E0, Y from $2F step $10; each cell uses the tile and property
tables, size 16x16; $FF cells are skipped. Called every frame from the Yoshi's House mode.

s0CA136.name: Table: tile numbers for ring sprites
summary: 16 tile numbers used by CODE_0CA183 (next chunk) for 16x16 sprites with properties $35.
